AUTHORED FIGURE BRIEF:
This figure illustrates the geometric relationship between heterogeneous (standard 2D) and homogeneous (projective) coordinate representations of the same 2D point. On the left, a point (x, y) exists in the standard Euclidean plane with axes x and y; on the right, the homogeneous coordinate space introduces a third axis w, and the canonical embedding of (x, y) is the point (x, y, 1) on the w=1 plane. A dashed ray extends from the origin through (x, y, 1) out to the general scalar multiple (lambda*x, lambda*y, lambda), showing that the entire ray through the origin corresponds to a single heterogeneous point, making scale irrelevant. This figure introduces the equivalence-class interpretation of homogeneous coordinates, which is the geometric foundation that allows projective transformations such as homographies to be expressed as linear matrix multiplications.

REQUESTED INTERACTIONS:
- Drag the 2D point (x, y) in the left plane and watch the corresponding 3D homogeneous ray in the right panel rotate through the origin while the canonical point (x, y, 1) stays pinned to the w=1 plane
- Slider for w: move the selected homogeneous representative along the right-panel ray and display the recovered heterogeneous coordinates (x/w, y/w) back on the left-panel point
- Toggle linked-view mode: highlight the left 2D point, the right canonical point (x, y, 1), and several scaled equivalents such as (2x, 2y, 2) as one shared equivalence class

SOURCE FILE: visionbook/homogeneous_coordinates.qmd

PROJECTION (inspect the source image, choose exactly one, and call setCameraView accordingly):
  perspective:
    Use the scaffold's true perspective projection after building all geometry. Use this only when the source has real vanishing-point convergence or distance-based size shrinkage; then depth should visibly affect apparent size.

  axonometric:
    Use ordinary orthographic projection: setCameraView({ projection: 'orthographic', axisScreenAngles, heightFraction }). If the source is a flat 2D plot or diagram, pass axisScreenAngles: null for a front-on view. Otherwise do not try to measure per-figure angles from the image — use a standard isometric pose: axisScreenAngles: { x: 30, z: 30 }. The source image is a PROJECTION of a 3D object: rebuild the true object — a rectangle stays a rectangle in world space — and let the camera do the projecting. Never bake the drawn parallelogram into the geometry, and never shear geometry. Omit zoom and call setCameraView after all geometry is added — the scaffold auto-fits from the projected bounding box.

  oblique:
    Call setCameraView({ projection: 'oblique', obliqueAngleDeg: 45, depthScale: 0.5, heightFraction }) after all geometry is added — a standard cabinet-oblique pose; do not try to measure per-figure oblique angles from the image. The scaffold implements oblique as a shear of the eye-space projection matrix, so the front face stays undistorted, depth edges leave at obliqueAngleDeg, and labels track the shear automatically. Build the TRUE 3D object — the shear is the camera's job. Do NOT shear geometry, do NOT wrap the figure in a sheared parent Object3D, and do NOT disable automatic matrix updates. The scaffold also provides the reveal interaction: dragging eases the shear out to expose the real 3D shape and a toggle button returns to the printed view — do not implement either yourself.
AXIS ASSIGNMENT: the pose is pinned, so in BoxGeometry(w, h, d) the w axis is screen-right, h is screen-up, and d is the receding diagonal. Before writing each BoxGeometry, look at the source image and decide which of the object's dimensions actually recedes there — do not assume it is the one the domain calls "depth". In feature-map / layer-stack diagrams the channel count is usually the w (horizontal) extent along the flow direction and a spatial dimension is d. Sanity-check the silhouette against the source: a block that should read as a long bar pointing at its neighbours must be long in w, not in d, or it will render as a sliver shooting into the page. If your chosen axis assignment contradicts the source image's silhouette, follow the image.

Build the figure directly from the brief above and the source image. There is no interaction plan: decide the elements, geometry, labels, and controls yourself.

Homogeneous coordinates
Drag the red point on the left plane, or use the sliders.
// @FIGURE_CODE_BEGIN // left Euclidean plane → transparent PlaneGeometry in the x-y plane at w=0 // right canonical plane → transparent PlaneGeometry in the x-y plane at w=1 // x, y, w axes → ArrowHelper plus thin negative-axis guide lines and w=1 tick // heterogeneous point (x,y) → red SphereGeometry on the left plane // canonical homogeneous point (x,y,1) → red SphereGeometry pinned to the w=1 plane // chosen representative (λx,λy,λ) → red SphereGeometry sliding along dashed ray // homogeneous ray → dashed Line from origin through all scaled representatives // embedding connector → solid Line from (x,y,0) to (x,y,1) // equivalence-class samples → small gold SphereGeometry objects on the same ray // labels → HTML labels for Heterogeneous, Homogeneous, axes, points, and w=1 tick document.getElementById('btnReset').style.display = ''; const hc = { x: 0.34, y: 0.52, lambda: 1.85, linked: true, defaults: { x: 0.34, y: 0.52, lambda: 1.85 } }; const xInput = document.getElementById('hcX'); const yInput = document.getElementById('hcY'); const wInput = document.getElementById('hcW'); const linkedInput = document.getElementById('hcLinked'); const resetInput = document.getElementById('hcReset'); const readout = document.getElementById('hcReadout'); const matBlack = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0x111111 }); const matGrey = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0x7d8f8e, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9 }); const matPlane = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xdfe9ea, transparent: true, opacity: 0.58, side: THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: false }); const matPlaneEdge = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0x738584, transparent: true, opacity: 0.95 }); const matRed = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff151b }); const matRedDark = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x171717 }); const matGold = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffc400 }); const matGoldWire = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffc400, wireframe: true, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9 }); const matDashed = new THREE.LineDashedMaterial({ color: 0x151515, dashSize: 0.075, gapSize: 0.045 }); function makeLine(points, material) { const line = new THREE.Line(new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(points), material); scene.add(line); return line; } function replaceLine(line, points, dashed = false) { const old = line.geometry; line.geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(points); if (dashed) line.computeLineDistances(); old.dispose(); } function makePlaneAtW(w) { const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.95, 2.35), matPlane.clone()); mesh.position.set(0, 0.18, w); scene.add(mesh); const x0 = -0.975, x1 = 0.975, y0 = -0.995, y1 = 1.355; const border = makeLine([ new THREE.Vector3(x0, y0, w), new THREE.Vector3(x1, y0, w), new THREE.Vector3(x1, y1, w), new THREE.Vector3(x0, y1, w), new THREE.Vector3(x0, y0, w) ], matPlaneEdge.clone()); return { mesh, border }; } const leftPlane = makePlaneAtW(0); const rightPlane = makePlaneAtW(1); registerInteractive(leftPlane.mesh, { title: 'Heterogeneous plane', tooltip: 'Ordinary 2D point (x,y)', body: 'The left plane is the usual Euclidean coordinate system. The red point stores only two numbers: x and y.' }); registerInteractive(rightPlane.mesh, { title: 'w = 1 plane', tooltip: 'Canonical homogeneous slice', body: 'The point (x,y) is embedded in homogeneous coordinates as (x,y,1), pinned to the plane w = 1.' }); const negX = makeLine([new THREE.Vector3(-1.35, 0, 0), new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0)], matBlack); const negY = makeLine([new THREE.Vector3(0, -1.05, 0), new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0)], matBlack); const xArrow = new THREE.ArrowHelper(new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0), 1.55, 0x111111, 0.16, 0.09); const yArrow = new THREE.ArrowHelper(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0), 1.52, 0x111111, 0.16, 0.09); const wArrow = new THREE.ArrowHelper(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1), new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0), 2.58, 0x111111, 0.18, 0.105); scene.add(xArrow, yArrow, wArrow); const tickW1 = makeLine([new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.075, 1), new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.075, 1)], matBlack); const originMarker = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.025, 16, 12), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x111111 })); originMarker.position.set(0, 0, 0); scene.add(originMarker); const leftPoint = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.072, 32, 18), matRed); const canonicalPoint = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.078, 32, 18), matRed.clone()); const selectedPoint = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.085, 32, 18), matRed.clone()); scene.add(leftPoint, canonicalPoint, selectedPoint); const leftPointRim = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.087, 32, 18), matRedDark); leftPointRim.scale.set(1.07, 1.07, 1.07); leftPointRim.renderOrder = -1; leftPoint.add(leftPointRim); const connectorLine = makeLine([new THREE.Vector3(), new THREE.Vector3()], matGrey.clone()); const rayLine = new THREE.Line(new THREE.BufferGeometry(), matDashed); scene.add(rayLine); const haloLeft = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.115, 24, 14), matGoldWire); const haloCanonical = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.122, 24, 14), matGoldWire.clone()); const haloSelected = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.132, 24, 14), matGoldWire.clone()); scene.add(haloLeft, haloCanonical, haloSelected); const sampleLambdas = [0.5, 1.35, 2.0]; const samplePoints = sampleLambdas.map((s) => { const p = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.045, 20, 12), matGold.clone()); p.userData.lambda = s; scene.add(p); registerInteractive(p, { title: `Scaled representative λ=${s}`, tooltip: `(${s}x, ${s}y, ${s}) is equivalent`, body: 'Any nonzero scalar multiple on the same ray has the same recovered heterogeneous coordinates x/w and y/w.' }); return p; }); registerInteractive(leftPoint, { title: 'Heterogeneous point', tooltip: 'Drag this point', body: 'Moving this point changes x and y. The whole homogeneous ray on the right rotates because it must still pass through (x,y,1).' }); registerInteractive(canonicalPoint, { title: 'Canonical homogeneous point', tooltip: '(x,y,1)', body: 'This is the standard embedding of a 2D point into homogeneous coordinates: keep x and y and set w = 1.' }); registerInteractive(selectedPoint, { title: 'Selected representative', tooltip: '(λx,λy,λ)', body: 'The slider chooses a different point on the same ray. Dividing by w recovers the same 2D coordinates.' }); function addBoundsAnchor(x, y, z) { const m = new THREE.Mesh( new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.01, 8, 6), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 0 }) ); m.position.set(x, y, z); scene.add(m); } [ [-1.75, 0.85, -0.12], [1.15, 0.85, 2.55], [1.55, -0.22, 2.65], [-1.35, -1.05, 0], [1.55, 1.45, 2.25] ].forEach(a => addBoundsAnchor(a[0], a[1], a[2])); setCameraView({ projection: 'orthographic', azimuthDeg: 135, elevationDeg: 35.264, target: [0.18, 0.12, 0.9], heightFraction: 0.73, distanceScale: 1.6 }); function labelSerif(entry, size = '25px', italic = false) { entry.div.style.fontFamily = 'serif'; entry.div.style.fontSize = size; if (italic) entry.div.style.fontStyle = 'italic'; return entry; } const lblHet = labelSerif(addLabel('Heterogeneous', new THREE.Vector3(-1.62, 0.78, -0.08), { fontSize: '28px' }), '28px'); const lblHom = labelSerif(addLabel('Homogeneous', new THREE.Vector3(1.08, 0.78, 2.45), { fontSize: '28px' }), '28px'); const lblX = labelSerif(addLabel('x', new THREE.Vector3(1.64, 0.08, 0), { fontSize: '29px', offset: [8, -6] }), '29px', true); const lblY = labelSerif(addLabel('y', new THREE.Vector3(0.02, 1.62, 0), { fontSize: '29px', offset: [8, -6] }), '29px', true); const lblW = labelSerif(addLabel('w', new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.08, 2.66), { fontSize: '29px', offset: [8, 8] }), '29px', true); const lblW1 = labelSerif(addLabel('1', new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.16, 1), { fontSize: '24px', offset: [0, 18] }), '24px'); const lblLeft = labelSerif(addLabel('(x,y)', new THREE.Vector3(), { fontSize: '24px', offset: [-4, -36] }), '24px', true); const lblCanon = labelSerif(addLabel('(x,y,1)', new THREE.Vector3(), { fontSize: '24px', offset: [10, 42] }), '24px', true); const lblSel = labelSerif(addLabel('(λx,λy,λ)', new THREE.Vector3(), { fontSize: '24px', offset: [10, -34] }), '24px', true); function fmt(v) { const s = Number(v).toFixed(2); return s.replace(/\.?0+$/, ''); } function updateHomogeneousFigure() { hc.x = Number(xInput.value); hc.y = Number(yInput.value); hc.lambda = Number(wInput.value); hc.linked = linkedInput.checked; const x = hc.x, y = hc.y, l = hc.lambda; const left = new THREE.Vector3(x, y, 0); const canon = new THREE.Vector3(x, y, 1); const selected = new THREE.Vector3(l * x, l * y, l); const rayEndScale = Math.max(2.35, l + 0.18); const rayEnd = new THREE.Vector3(rayEndScale * x, rayEndScale * y, rayEndScale); leftPoint.position.copy(left); canonicalPoint.position.copy(canon); selectedPoint.position.copy(selected); haloLeft.position.copy(left); haloCanonical.position.copy(canon); haloSelected.position.copy(selected); replaceLine(connectorLine, [left, canon]); replaceLine(rayLine, [new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0), rayEnd], true); samplePoints.forEach((p, i) => { const s = sampleLambdas[i]; p.position.set(s * x, s * y, s); p.visible = hc.linked; }); haloLeft.visible = hc.linked; haloCanonical.visible = hc.linked; haloSelected.visible = hc.linked; matDashed.color.set(hc.linked ? 0xc89400 : 0x151515); canonicalPoint.scale.setScalar(hc.linked ? 1.12 : 1); selectedPoint.scale.setScalar(hc.linked ? 1.12 : 1); leftPoint.scale.setScalar(hc.linked ? 1.1 : 1); lblLeft.pos.copy(left).add(new THREE.Vector3(-0.05, 0.06, 0)); lblCanon.pos.copy(canon).add(new THREE.Vector3(0.05, -0.02, 0)); lblSel.pos.copy(selected).add(new THREE.Vector3(0.05, 0.05, 0)); const recX = selected.x / selected.z; const recY = selected.y / selected.z; readout.innerHTML = `2D point: (${fmt(x)}, ${fmt(y)})
` + `selected: (${fmt(selected.x)}, ${fmt(selected.y)}, ${fmt(selected.z)})
` + `recover: (${fmt(selected.x)}/${fmt(selected.z)}, ${fmt(selected.y)}/${fmt(selected.z)}) = ` + `(${fmt(recX)}, ${fmt(recY)})`; window.__hcState = { x, y, lambda: l, recovered: [recX, recY] }; } [xInput, yInput, wInput, linkedInput].forEach(el => el.addEventListener('input', updateHomogeneousFigure)); resetInput.addEventListener('click', () => { xInput.value = hc.defaults.x; yInput.value = hc.defaults.y; wInput.value = hc.defaults.lambda; linkedInput.checked = true; updateHomogeneousFigure(); }); const dragRaycaster = new THREE.Raycaster(); const dragPointer = new THREE.Vector2(); const dragPlane = new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1), 0); const dragHit = new THREE.Vector3(); let draggingLeftPoint = false; function setDragPointer(event) { const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); dragPointer.x = ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1; dragPointer.y = -((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1; } canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => { setDragPointer(event); dragRaycaster.setFromCamera(dragPointer, camera); const hits = dragRaycaster.intersectObject(leftPoint, true); if (!hits.length) return; draggingLeftPoint = true; controls.enabled = false; canvas.setPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId); }); canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => { if (!draggingLeftPoint) return; setDragPointer(event); dragRaycaster.setFromCamera(dragPointer, camera); if (dragRaycaster.ray.intersectPlane(dragPlane, dragHit)) { xInput.value = String(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(dragHit.x, Number(xInput.min), Number(xInput.max))); yInput.value = String(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(dragHit.y, Number(yInput.min), Number(yInput.max))); updateHomogeneousFigure(); } }); window.addEventListener('pointerup', (event) => { if (!draggingLeftPoint) return; draggingLeftPoint = false; controls.enabled = true; try { canvas.releasePointerCapture?.(event.pointerId); } catch {} }); updateHomogeneousFigure(); // @FIGURE_CODE_END
